title: Need to put age appropriate on order
text: I received a Bunny James as a get well gift. Inside was an adult coloring book which was made of thin grayish newsprint and the book had a price of $3.95 on it!  The color book and colored pencils were the main gift. The lip balm was a funky scent.  My box was age appropriate for 12-28.  Not for me.
label: negative
